title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
description: Return the node values level by level, visiting each level from left to right.
note: Capture the queue size once per level, then process those nodes in FIFO order.
notes: The empty-tree guard returns an empty result. Other presence checks use != none explicitly, so a node containing zero is still visited.
queue([root]) creates a FIFO queue containing one node. push adds at the back and pop removes from the front. Construction retains node references without copying the tree.

repeat pending.size evaluates the queue size once on entry. It processes only the current level; children enqueued during the body wait for the next outer iteration. Python's range(len(pending)) captures the same count.
LeetCode supplies TreeNode. The record declaration shows how the same type would be defined in a standalone Birdie program.
The traversal takes O(n) time and O(w) auxiliary queue space, where w is the maximum level width, plus O(n) output space. It does not modify the tree.
